_about: 25 takes dictated into the Kivi Windows app, one per hotkey press. 'asr' is the speech model's text and 'formatted' is the formatter's, the same two inputs this system receives at runtime. Nothing is cherry-picked: the mangles the system cannot recover from are kept too, and DATA.md section 2 lists which ones became eval cases. The four Hindi takes came back from the speech model in Hindi script; they are written here in Roman script, as the formatter emits them and as this system reads them.
